messages:
ada_m: Noticed weird delta after rolling Parrot-lite int8 to 10% canary on dedicated-a. Parse failures for funcall payloads jumped from ~0.4% -> 3.4% in the last 30m.

chris_p: Any specific error classes? missing bracket, truncated stream, garbage prefix?

ada_m: Mix of things. Fast sample: 40% trailing commas in objects, 25% unexpected leading commas in arrays, remainder are duplicated keys or partial array fragments like `[,\"tool\":\"x\"]`.

samir: That leading comma in arrays screams streaming boundary mis-align. Does the client-side streaming boundary matcher or our chunk reassembly change under batching?

lena_k: Correlating with runtime config: the canary used batch alignment optimization (batch_pad=true) to reduce kernel launches. Pool telemetry shows higher chunk coalescing.

samir: Ok that matches a hypothesis: batch coalescing + kv-prefix replay could insert an extra separator token when suffixes are concatenated.

ada_m: I ran a small mirror capture: raw outputs (no postprocess) saved to s3://redwood-infer/parrot/onboard/6266667777/raw/ . Sample shows sequence: `...\"items\": [\n,\n{...}` where the comma appears immediately after a newline boundary.

chris_p: Could be newline token -> comma token decoding shift in quantized model. Is the tokenizer identical to baseline?

lena_k: Token diffs show identical token ids, but logits for comma vs newline at that position have similar mass in int8. Slight rounding pushes comma over threshold after calibration tweak.

samir: So two vectors: numeric nudging from PTQ and a streaming concat bug amplify visible problems.

ada_m: Suggested mitigations: 1) disable batch_pad on canary (cheap toggle), 2) enable json-sanitizer on mirror pipeline, 3) run fuzz harness that simulates chunk coalescing with parity between fp16 and int8 to reproduce.

chris_p: +1. Also propose lightweight in-flight fixer: if parse fails, attempt `json_transformer.fix_trailing_commas()` then reparse and only count as failure if still invalid. We have that in infra tools.

samir: I'll schedule the fuzz run now. Config matrix: batch_pad={on,off}, batch_size={1,4,8}, kv_replay={true,false}. Will push initial results in ~90min.

lena_k: I'll upload 300 failing traces with token logs and model logits to S3 path above for triage.

ops-bot: Canary throttle command executed: set canary_percent=5 for parrot-lite int8 on dedicated-a per ada_m request.

ada_m: Rolling changes: 1) flip batch_pad=false on pool, 2) enable sanitizer on mirror. Deploy queued.

chris_p: If flipping batch_pad reduces failures to <0.8% we can keep int8 and iterate on calibration. If not, plan to revert to fp16 and open a regression ticket linking the PTQ run id.

samir: Note: the PTQ run is run-2026-03-08-ptq-v42 (calib set: 2000 samples, one extra epoch). I suspect the extra epoch nudged punctuation logits. Will try a re-calib with clipped out punctuation tokens as ablation.

ada_m: Thanks team. I'll post the fuzz results and mirror sanitizer stats once available. Short and noisy thread but wanted to capture action items here so SRE/product have context. :sparkles:
